title: Hold a utility knife with one hand while the other pushes its blade in, then put it away in the drawer
instruction: Hold the utility knife with one hand and with the other push its slider button back until the blade is fully in, then put the knife in the drawer and let go. Never put it in the drawer with the blade out.
context: A utility knife left in a drawer or toolbox with its blade out cuts the next hand that reaches in; workshops and warehouses require the blade retracted before a knife is put down or away. The slider button needs a firm push, so one hand holds the knife while the other pushes it home.
setup: A table in front of two arms (bases 61 cm apart), seen by one overhead camera and a camera on each wrist. Distances are measured forward from the line between the arm bases and sideways from the midpoint between them. (1) A loose yellow utility knife, 90 g, 17 cm long, 1.8 cm wide and 2.8 cm tall, lying spine up along the left-right line 30 cm forward, its middle 1 cm right of the centre line, a dark rubber grip at its left (rear) end. Its blade sticks out 3 cm at its right end; the dark slider button, on the spine 5 cm right of the knife's middle, slides 3 cm back (left) to bring the blade fully in and clicks home there. (2) A fixed grey tool drawer (an open tray), 12 x 23 cm inside and 3.5 cm tall, centred 30 cm forward and 25 cm left. The layout is the same in every trial, as in the screenshot.
scoring: Judged at the end of the trial. The button has two detents, blade out and blade in; past half way it clicks to the nearer one. Blade in: the button at least 2.5 cm back. In the drawer: the knife's middle inside the drawer, below its rim. If the knife is ever in the drawer with its blade out, the trial scores 0. Otherwise 1.0: the blade in, the knife in the drawer, and both grippers' fingertip centres (TCPs) at least 3 cm from the knife; 0.5: the blade in; 0.25: the button pushed back at least 1 cm at some point; else 0.0. The trial ends at the run limit, or once the full score has held with the knife still for 1 s.
reset_notes: Take the knife out of the drawer, push the blade back out to its forward click and lay the knife where it was.
fidelity: Rigid-body simulation (Isaac Sim 6.1, PhysX, 20 Hz control). Simplified: the button and blade are one body on a slide in the knife, held by a spring toward the nearer of its two detents (about 4.5 N to push it over the middle); the blade does not collide and cannot cut. The drawer is a fixed open tray. Cameras 1280 x 704 (Dream-1 sees 320 x 176).
